findings.statement: The D-061 r4 oracle report (sha256 56529e65, verdict PASS) was verified check-by-check against the frozen r4 contract: all 11 checks true on all 8 family states, five preregistered mutants killed with the restoration canary bitwise, N8 anchors exactly equal to the D-055 values with the division identity numerator/D_anchor reproduced, module sha 760a7c04..., numpy 2.4.4, mpmath 1.3.0, and recomputed margins hold (max asymmetric N3 5.092e-11 under the 1e-10 cap at 1.96x, SB N3 ~3.53e-11 under 2.5e-10 at 7.1x, every certified residual hi under its block cap with float64 N3 inside the certified band). The adjudicated one-change supersession discipline held exactly: a leaf-level diff of the r3 and r4 reports shows 17 deltas, all within the permitted scope (contract string, verdict, wall_seconds, the added N7X gated field, and N7X_exchange/ok flipping true only on P-fixed SS-A/SS-C/SS-D with gated:false and the degenerate sup values still recorded), while every physics number - per-state N1/N2/N3/N4/D_cov, N7X sup_rel, certified residual lo/hi, W_int, entropy, mutant margins, and the 1522656/0 M-INT-2 containment counters - is bitwise identical to the preserved r3 FAIL, and the oracle-script diff contains exactly the docstring/contract-name strings, the single gating predicate (n7x["ok"] or p_fixed), and the gated record field. The r4 contract PASS is therefore admissible and C-F10-METROLOGY-R3 earns a VALIDATED status recommendation, with the explicit reservation that the G-F10-COVARIANCE-METROLOGY gate flip itself is deferred to the D-063 single-writer reconsideration after the D-062 trajectory program (D-057 remedy step 5). Recorded limitations: single execution on a single host/platform; same-model authorship and blind reviews; the interval tiers certify the production graph only on the frozen matched family, not a general-state proof; and the SS N7X non-gating rests on the degeneracy rationale (elastic energy conservation zeroes the Pauli affinity for shared mu/tau logit slopes, making the relative metric noise/noise at ~0.05) rather than on a measured equivariance bound at those states.
